name: Mega Marketplace

requiredPages.purpose: Search-first marketplace landing page with departments, deals, product rails, and trust signals.
Filterable product listing with categories, search, sorting, price filters, ratings, and vendor/product cards.
Product detail page with gallery, price, vendor, shipping, variants, reviews, and add-to-cart.
Multi-vendor cart grouped by vendor, showing shipping and checkout readiness.
Secure checkout flow that can split one checkout into multiple vendor orders.
Customer orders, addresses, profile, saved items, and support.
Vendor product management, order management, sales summary, and payout status.

aiUsageRules: AI may choose copy, ordering, category labels, product descriptions, and visual tone.
AI must not invent unsupported component types.
AI must not output raw HTML, raw JavaScript, or arbitrary CSS.
AI must produce structured JSON that conforms to the template data contracts.
AI must preserve the selected template family unless the user explicitly asks to change it.
AI must adapt the marketplace to the client business instead of pasting client notes directly into the page.
